name: B10-0439/2025 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for two Spanish citizens held in Equatorial Guinea, Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta, to be released and treated properly. They have been in Black Beach prison since 22 January 2025, reportedly in poor conditions, with health problems and limited access to lawyers, doctors, consular help and family. The Parliament strongly criticises their detention and the country's prison conditions. This is a statement of concern and a set of demands; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands better treatment and respect for the two detainees' rights.
- **Who it affects:** The two detained Spanish citizens, their families, and Equatorial Guinea's authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU bodies and Equatorial Guinea's government; EU diplomats are urged to keep pressing the case.
